description: Maps keywords, file patterns, and paths to relevant skills for auto-activation. The 'paths' field aligns with SKILL.md frontmatter 'paths' for cross-tool compatibility.

rules.message: Use `us scaffold app` to create new apps. Do not manually create project files.
This is a desktop app. Consider /setup-pear-desktop for Pear desktop setup.
This looks like a terminal/service app. Consider /setup-pear-terminal for a headless Pear app.
This is a mobile app. Consider /setup-mobile-app for Expo + Bare setup.
This is a Node.js CLI app. Consider /setup-node-cli for customization patterns.
This involves P2P networking. Consider /add-p2p-networking for Hyperswarm setup.
This involves P2P RPC. Consider /add-p2p-rpc for bare-rpc patterns.
This looks like a data sync task. Consider /add-p2p-sync for Hypercore replication.
This needs multi-writer sync. Consider /add-multi-writer-sync for Autobase convergent state.
This involves secure messaging. Consider /add-encrypted-channels for encrypted Protomux channels.
This is a storage pattern. Consider /add-kv-storage for Hyperbee offline-first storage.
This involves structured data. Consider /add-database for HyperDB with schema and indexes.
This involves file storage. Consider /add-file-storage for Hyperdrive.
This involves AI inference. Consider /add-ai-chat for QVAC chat and tool calling.
This involves image analysis. Consider /add-ai-vision for QVAC multimodal vision.
This involves audio transcription. Consider /add-ai-transcription for QVAC Whisper.
This involves RAG/search. Consider /add-ai-rag for QVAC embeddings and vector search.
This involves payments/wallet. Consider /add-wallet for WDK patterns.
This involves P2P testing. Consider /setup-local-testing for local DHT bootstrap.
